map.留针时长按病症与体质：一般病症 20 至 30 分钟、急性疼痛 10 至 20: Retention time depends on the disorder and the constitution: 20 to 30 minutes for general disorders, 10 to 20 minutes for acute pain, and 30 to 45 minutes for chronic deficiency patterns. The frail, the elderly, children and those undergoing acupuncture for the first time should have a short retention (10 to 20 minutes), while the sturdy with excess heat may have it extended appropriately. Usually the treatment is given once daily or every other day, with 10 to 12 sessions per course and a rest of 3 to 5 days between courses. Fainting during acupuncture, hunger, fatigue, and the lumbar and abdominal points in pregnancy call for shortening or avoidance.
